svg.title: Three Core Seats, Five at Scale
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-06-core-and-scaled-pod; chart type: org_architecture; title: Three Core Seats, Five at Scale; subtitle: The principal owns capital decisions; specialists own defined work.; chapter number: 11; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: FT means full-time and C means contractor. Conservative and Base use 1 FT + 2 C, totaling three people. Scaled uses 2 FT + 3 C, totaling five people. The principal remains the investment decision owner in both structures.; caption: Canonical annual outcomes: Conservative $15,000 gross at 30% margin yields $4,500 owner net; Base $97,500 gross at 42.5% yields $41,438 rounded owner net; Scaled $180,000 gross at 55% yields $99,000 owner net. All gross figures exclude returned principal, and the scaled result uses five people.; stages: label: Principal investor; value: Core seat one: full-time capital decision owner; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Sets county coverage, concentration limits, bid ceilings, reserve policy, and acquisition decisions. Reviews cash reconciliation and maintains the distinction between invested basis, recovered principal, realized revenue, and owner profit.; label: Title and parcel reviewer; value: Core seat two: contracted title research specialist; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Reports recorded interests, legal-description mismatches, access issues, parcel fragmentation, and unresolved exceptions. Delivers dated evidence packets rather than treating assessor records as proof of clear title.; label: Local enforcement counsel; value: Core seat three: contracted jurisdiction-specific counsel; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Owns legal interpretation, notice sequencing, stay analysis, federal lien issues, enforcement filings, and surplus treatment. Distinguishes ordinary retainer work from separately budgeted litigation.; label: Portfolio operations lead; value: Scaled seat four: second full-time operating seat; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Added only in the five-person model. Maintains the SQLite portfolio register, redemption calendar, bank matching, document versioning, and overdue exception queue; the principal retains capital authority.; label: Auction and field analyst; value: Scaled seat five: third contracted specialist seat; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Added only in the five-person model. Cleans auction files, verifies property conditions, collects local sale evidence, and documents inspection exceptions without substituting desktop estimates for title review.

text.title: Three Core Seats, Five at Scale
text.tspan: Three Core Seats, Five at Scale

circle.title: label: Principal investor; value: Core seat one: full-time capital decision owner; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Sets county coverage, concentration limits, bid ceilings, reserve policy, and acquisition decisions. Reviews cash reconciliation and maintains the distinction between invested basis, recovered principal, realized revenue, and owner profit.

text.title: Sets county coverage, concentration limits, bid ceilings, reserve policy, and acquisition decisions. Reviews cash reconciliation and maintains the distinction between invested basis, recovered principal, realized revenue, and owner profit.

circle.title: label: Title and parcel reviewer; value: Core seat two: contracted title research specialist; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Reports recorded interests, legal-description mismatches, access issues, parcel fragmentation, and unresolved exceptions. Delivers dated evidence packets rather than treating assessor records as proof of clear title.

text.title: Reports recorded interests, legal-description mismatches, access issues, parcel fragmentation, and unresolved exceptions. Delivers dated evidence packets rather than treating assessor records as proof of clear title.

circle.title: label: Local enforcement counsel; value: Core seat three: contracted jurisdiction-specific counsel; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Owns legal interpretation, notice sequencing, stay analysis, federal lien issues, enforcement filings, and surplus treatment. Distinguishes ordinary retainer work from separately budgeted litigation.

text.title: Owns legal interpretation, notice sequencing, stay analysis, federal lien issues, enforcement filings, and surplus treatment. Distinguishes ordinary retainer work from separately budgeted litigation.

circle.title: label: Portfolio operations lead; value: Scaled seat four: second full-time operating seat; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Added only in the five-person model. Maintains the SQLite portfolio register, redemption calendar, bank matching, document versioning, and overdue exception queue; the principal retains capital authority.

text.title: Added only in the five-person model. Maintains the SQLite portfolio register, redemption calendar, bank matching, document versioning, and overdue exception queue; the principal retains capital authority.

circle.title: label: Auction and field analyst; value: Scaled seat five: third contracted specialist seat; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Added only in the five-person model. Cleans auction files, verifies property conditions, collects local sale evidence, and documents inspection exceptions without substituting desktop estimates for title review.

text.title: Added only in the five-person model. Cleans auction files, verifies property conditions, collects local sale evidence, and documents inspection exceptions without substituting desktop estimates for title review.

Assumptions: FT means full-time and C means contractor. Conservative and Base use 1 FT + 2 C, totaling three people. Scaled uses 2 FT + 3 C, totaling five people. The principal remains the investment decision owner in both structures.
